raw.query: WITH vals AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN timing='aic' THEN effective_p99_ttft_ms END) AS aic_p99, MAX(CASE WHEN timing='poly' THEN effective_p99_ttft_ms END) AS poly_p99, MAX(CASE WHEN timing='aic' THEN effective_max_ttft_ms END) AS aic_max, MAX(CASE WHEN timing='poly' THEN effective_max_ttft_ms END) AS poly_max, MAX(CASE WHEN timing='aic' THEN srcbuild_mean_itl_ms END) AS aic_itl, MAX(CASE WHEN timing='poly' THEN srcbuild_mean_itl_ms END) AS poly_itl FROM provenance.llm_head2k_poly_aic_effective) SELECT aic_p99/poly_p99 AS r_p99, aic_max/poly_max AS r_max, aic_itl/poly_itl AS r_itl_mean FROM vals;
raw.observed: ratio_p99=1.2371, ratio_max=1.7786, ratio_itl_mean=1.1306 (p99 ITL actually goes the other way: 0.762x — aic 22.6 ms vs poly 29.7 ms)
